Packs Money and the saved bankrolls and the progress bytes into PasswordBytes, appends a checksum (two's complement of the byte sum), splits everything into nibbles and maps each nibble through the per-position alphabet row (PasswordAlphabet5) into PasswordBuffer.

units.name: VramStructWrite
units.summary: VramStructWrite (FDS BIOS format): BiosArg0/1 -> list of records [addr hi, addr lo, flags+length, data...]. Flags: bit 7 = +32 increment, bit 6 = repeat one byte, length 0 = 64. $60 returns from a nested list, $4C <word> calls a nested list, an address with bit 7 set ends the list. Writes to $3Fxx re-point the PPU to $3F00/$0000 afterwards.

editorial_audit.notes: Final editorial audit (final acceptance, checkpoint pass-003). Reused round-2 review credit for all 1582 scaffold entries; revisited only concrete inconsistencies found by targeted checks (comment headers vs labels, names in prose without definitions, Label+large-offset operands, raw cross-bank operands, generic review summaries). Applied L15 wording (password 25-bit packing, unread constant fields BjDealerRecordTable +10 / PkOpponentTriples +0, static writers of blackjack codes 1/2/3/8; corrected the redirect note: code 3 is written by BlackjackSession, not BjSettleHand). Added 16 sub-table data labels replacing Label+offset operands (title, scene, password, cursor and bet tables), shrank MenuCursorPos to 10 bytes so portrait animation bytes read as PortraitAnimId/MouthFrame/EyeFrame etc., bank constants and comments on remaining raw bank-6/bank-3 calls, fixed two header/label mismatches (PokerShowdown, RunNmiTaskAndWait) and 8 stale prose names, added notes for 7 tables lacking any description, and made cmtreview.py derive data-table summaries from consumer comments. Details: commentary/editorial-audit.md.
